description:
The 'InsectSprays.csv' dataset is loaded in Jamovi. Your goal is to run a Linear Regression to compare the effectiveness of Spray A against Spray F, treating Spray F as the reference baseline.

1. Go to the Data tab and modify the 'spray' variable properties so that 'F' is the Reference Level (first level) instead of the default 'A'.
2. Run a Linear Regression (Analyses > Regression > Linear Regression) with 'count' as the Dependent Variable and 'spray' as a Factor.
3. Save the Jamovi project as '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/InsectSprays_Ref_F.omv'.
4. Create a text file at '/home/ga/Documents/Jamovi/coefficients_report.txt' containing the value of the Intercept and the coefficient for Spray A from the Model Coefficients table.
